framing: Short-term holder seller exhaustion, updated daily. Not a sell trigger.

labels.a: Underwater share hit 95%+ and has dropped 10+ pts
labels.b: Weekly losses down 50%+ from the spike

gauge_caption: 3 of 3 has followed every major low since 2015, usually 3-10 weeks after the bottom. In bear markets about half of first readings were followed by a lower low within 6 months (12 of 23 held since 2011).
notes: Short-term holders are coins moved in the last 155 days. Underwater share is the percent of that supply whose cost is above the day's close.
Values are the last finished UTC day. Refreshed daily by refresh_sth_exhaustion.py. Never invented.
3 of 3 is a historical marker that short-term selling in that wave had faded, not a sell or exit signal.
